cues.text: Makkale, CA Final Direct Tax padikkumbol block of assets-um section 32 depreciation-um romba important aanu! P & M block-il 15% and 40% rates engane work cheyyunnu, put to use days engane affect cheyyunnu ennathu nokkaam.
Ithu full normal depreciation 15% kittum, pinne eligible manufacturing enterprise aanengil additional depreciation 20% koodi claim cheyyam!
Oru financial year-il 180 days-il kuravaanu asset put to use cheythathu enkil, normal depreciation 7.5% aayi restrict cheyyum, additional depreciation 10% aakum.
Examples polulla Windmills 40% block-il varum. 180 days-il kooduthal use cheythal full 40% normal depreciation kittum.
Computers or high-rate machinery 180 days-il kuravaanu use cheythathu enkil, rate 20% aayi reduce aavum!
PQR Textile Ltd. poleulla manufacturing companies-kku pudhiya machinery install cheythal additional depreciation 20% kittum. Pakshe conditions strict aanu ketto.
Company must be engaged in manufacture or production of articles or things to claim section 32(1)(iia).
180 days or more-o, atho 180 days-il kuravo ennathu check cheyyuka.
180 days-il kooduthal enkil full 20%, kuravaanengil 50% mathram yaathoru thadassavum illathe 10% aayi restriction varum.
Oru financial year-il asset acquire cheythittu put to use ey cheythillengil, oru depreciation-um claim cheyyan pattilla!
PQR Textile Ltd. textile fabrics manufacture cheyyunnathu kondu avaru eligible manufacturing unit aanu, so additional depreciation conditions check cheyyanam.
Acquisition cost-kku payment account payee cheque, ECS, or bank transfer vazhi cheyyanam, warna actual cost computation-il problem varum.
Windmills 40% block-il varum, athupole lorries used for transporting goods to sales depots-um block calculation-il sradhikkuka.
Fork-lift trucks used inside factory premises are part of plant and machinery, subject to 180-days threshold check.
